preconditions.description: Both input arguments must be strings.
Both input strings must contain at least one character.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in seq1 for i in range(len(return_value))) and all(return_value[i] in seq2 for i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: Every character in the returned string must appear in both input sequences.

postconditions.expression: lambda s1, s2, sub: (lambda it: all(next(it) == c for c in sub))(iter(s1)) and (lambda it: all(next(it) == c for c in sub))(iter(s2))
postconditions.description: The returned string must be a valid subsequence of both input strings, preserving relative order.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == max((len(cand) for cand in (lambda s1, s2: [c for c in [s1[i] + s2[j] for i in range(len(s1)) for j in range(len(s2))] if all(c[k] == s1[i] and c[k] == s2[j] for k in range(len(c)))])(seq1, seq2)))
postconditions.description: The returned string must have the maximum possible length among all common subsequences of the two inputs.
